mentions.name: Semicolony
mentions.description: This project publishes ambient and electronic music recordings, spanning both newly made and decades-old pieces, as free downloads on the Semicolony Bandcamp page. It serves to give closure to musical ideas begun 30 years ago.
mentions.source_excerpt: I spent some weekends and after-work evenings tidying up some ambient and electronic recordings both new and old, and today I finally decided to publish it on bandcamp: https://semicolony.bandcamp.com/
